title: AeroSwap
tagline: Lightning-fast, gas-optimized token swaps with best rates via 1inch aggregation.
description:
AeroSwap is a next-generation decentralized token swap platform built on top of the 1inch Aggregation Protocol. Designed for speed, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness, AeroSwap empowers users to execute lightning-fast token swaps across multiple DEXs while securing the best available rates. By leveraging 1inch’s intelligent routing algorithm, AeroSwap splits trades across various liquidity sources to minimize slippage and reduce gas costs.

With a sleek, user-friendly interface, AeroSwap caters to both beginners and advanced DeFi traders, offering real-time price comparisons, optimized routing, and seamless execution—all without relying on external custodial services or third-party APIs outside of 1inch.

✨ Key Features:
🚀 Best-Rate Execution: Aggregates liquidity from leading DEXs to ensure optimal swap prices.
💸 Gas Optimization: Intelligent trade routing minimizes transaction fees on every swap.
⚡ High-Speed Transactions: Built for near-instant trade confirmations on supported networks.
🔒 Non-Custodial & Secure: Users maintain full control of their funds at all times.
🌐 Future-Ready Architecture: Designed to easily expand to new chains and liquidity sources as DeFi evolves.
how_its_made:
AeroSwap is built using a React + Next.js frontend powered by Ethers.js for blockchain interactions and 1inch Aggregation Protocol smart contracts for optimized token swaps.

⚙️ Tech Stack:
💻 Frontend: React, Next.js for fast, responsive UI
🔗 Blockchain Interaction: Ethers.js for contract calls and wallet integration
🧠 Swap Logic: 1inch smart contracts for routing and best-rate execution
🛠️ Smart Contracts: Solidity for custom utilities and swap enhancements

We designed AeroSwap to work fully client-side, avoiding centralized servers. The platform fetches quotes, routes trades, and executes transactions directly on-chain via 1inch contracts.

We used a gas-optimized transaction batching technique, allowing multiple split swaps to be executed in fewer calls, reducing fees. The interface also preloads liquidity sources for faster quote generation, making swaps almost instant.
